target: distinct positive qualifying invoice IDs in UK per calendar week
week: Monday inclusive to next Monday exclusive; naive source timestamps, no verified timezone
qualification: country United Kingdom, quantity>0, unit_price>0, invoice_id nonblank and not cancellation C; customer ID not required
deduplication: Invoice ID counted once per week; matching copies across sheets and repeated item lines cannot inflate distinct invoice counts. Invoice IDs observed on multiple dates are reported; grouping uses week and invoice ID.
partial_boundaries: exclude first week starting 2009-11-30 and last week starting 2011-12-05; assume calendar coverage within source extrema, not verified warehouse completeness
forecast: one week ahead at Monday; use only completed weeks strictly before cutoff
availability: zero ingestion delay assumed retrospectively; not verified source fact
selection: lowest development WAPE; exact tie retains previous_week baseline
final: only selected method; no tuning or comparison of challengers on final
stress_checks: live plan update preserves frozen evidence
repeat persistence and reading in independent destination
deliberately wrong last-period label in QA copy is detected
